witness_coordinate_convention: For movable leaf pins the witness source_corner is that leaf, destination_corner is the fixed peer; logical signal direction is specified in bit label and may be the reverse.
next: If a leaf has zero reach origins, change source/target geometry. If reach origins exist but none free, grant/rehome the connected cluster. Do not admit missing leaf placements.
timing_rule: min(500um,(833.334ps-60ps-skew-launch-capture)/0.76ps_per_um), skew90samelevel/150crosslevel, actual TT pin metrics at phi-R

world_proposal.ectl_rule: Preserve canonical216um offset; R0 no own-column shift, MY+54. Do not recenter+27.
world_proposal.physical_limits: Other cut-crossing instances require real generator relocation and all changed paths/cuts/clocks remeasurement. This proposal is not a floorplan grant.

necessary_routing_capacity.assumption: Normalized track demand at0.096um/bit and55percent occupancy; necessary layer count only, actual metal directions and obstructions require backend admission.
